show.description:
A beggar who is secretly a billionaire hides his true identity for the sake of love.
But the closer he gets to her, the harder it becomes to protect his secret.
Every moment tests his courage as lies, destiny, and danger tighten around him.
Watch this gripping story unfold—only on Kuku TV.
